[Sennard checkpoint status] Work record: none.
Before answering or the next tool, match this message (questions and check requests included) against the skill targets and call each match before that judgment or action; apply the intake's pre-action checks before building, resuming, reporting or a next step.
If the Sennard intake says to checkpoint it: re-select skills for it, then checkpoint_context.
Before stopping, save any change the user gave you with checkpoint_context or checkpoint_role_context. If there is nothing to save, call mark_turn_unchanged.
Compaction, resume or fork with no current state in view: inspect_context, then load_context.

[Sennard parent link] This host's hooks do not say which conversation started this one, so Sennard cannot tell whether this is the main conversation or a subagent. If you are a subagent, call any Sennard tool once now: that call names this conversation and its parent, and from the next step Sennard gives you the parent's role context. If you are the main conversation, ignore this.
